stop_reason: RDF profile, FP values, and FP-based heavy-atom ranking were all stable (max FP relative change <= 10%, max RDF normalised RMSD <= 15%, Spearman rank correlation >= 0.9) across 3 consecutive block-to-block transitions.
FP_method: WaterFP (github.com/valeriorizzi/WaterFP, Scripts/fp.py): FP = trapz(-2*pi*norm*(g*ln(g)-g+1)*r^2, dx=0.001 nm) over r in [0,2.001] nm, g(r)=n(r)/norm, norm=mean of last 500 of 2001 bins of the raw water-O number-density profile n(r) around the ligand heavy atom.
